verdict.rationale: Pigment's security page explicitly states that customer data is stored in the region the customer chooses: europe-west3 (Frankfurt) or us-west1 (Oregon). That directly delivers region selection, but only two regions are documented and nothing describes how the choice is made or its scope. Missing for 10: more than two region options, details on how region is selected and whether it covers AI/agent processing and backups, independent or hands-on corroboration.
